channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Rebound meets strong USD resistance – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note that the Canadian Dollar (CAD) has held up well through recent Iran-driven volatility, extending its rebound even as the US Dollar (USD) trades mixed.

item.title: Gold steadies as markets assess US-Iran tensions, FOMC minutes awaited
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) steadies after coming under heavy selling pressure earlier on Wednesday as Reuters reported that US President Donald Trump did not repeat his earlier comments on ending the interim Iran deal during the NATO summit, citing a source familiar with the talks.

item.title: Fed Minutes to shed light on Warsh's first meeting as Chair
item.description: The United States (US) Federal Reserve (Fed) will release the Minutes of the June 16-17 Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on Wednesday at 18:00 GMT. The Minutes should shed more light on the Fed’s hawkish hold delivered at Kevin Warsh’s first meeting as Fed Chair.

item.title: United States: Inflation expectations edge higher as oil rises – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research’s Philip Wee reports that the New York Fed’s June Survey of Consumer Expectations showed 1-year inflation expectations rising to 3.7%, with 3-year expectations at 3.3% and 5-year unchanged at 3%.

item.title: Canada: Trade surplus at four-year high – NBC
item.description: National Bank of Canada’s (NBC) strategist Alexandra Ducharme reports Canada’s merchandise trade surplus hit a four-year high in May as exports reached a record C$77.1 billion. Gains were driven by metal ores and non-metallic minerals, while energy exports declined.

item.title: WTI Oil advances on Trump’s Iran shift, mounting Middle East supply risks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) US Oil trades around $73.10 on Wednesday at the time of writing, up 1.48% on the day, as investors reassess risks to global energy supply following a renewed deterioration in geopolitical conditions across the Middle East.

item.title: Japanese Yen falls as renewed US-Iran tensions boost the US Dollar, Oil prices
item.description: USD/JPY edges higher on Wednesday as renewed escalation in the Middle East boosts demand for the US Dollar (USD) and lifts Oil prices, weighing on the Japanese Yen (JPY). At the time of writing, the pair is trading around 162.50, close to 40-year highs.

item.title: British Pound: Pound resilience faces political risks – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley highlights that the British Pound (GBP) has been a strong G10 performer this year, supported by sticky United Kingdom (UK) inflation, Bank of England (BoE) rate expectations and inbound M&A flows.

item.title: Euro: Political risks but downside bias – ING
item.description: Francesco Pesole at ING discusses Euro resilience despite French political developments, including Marine Le Pen’s 2027 bid and expectations of an RN win.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar: RBNZ hawkish path supports currency – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports that the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) delivered a 25 bps hike to 2.50%, largely priced in, triggering an New Zealand Dollar (NZD) rally before gains were trimmed by Middle East tensions.

item.title: US Dollar: Warsh risks skewed to cuts – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Antje Praefcke argues that interest rate differentials are again driving the Dollar, with USD reacting strongly to weaker US data as markets reassess new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

item.title: Oil: Conflict-driven volatility and positioning – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu highlights growing fragility in global markets as President Trump declares the Iran ceasefire over and U.S. strikes in the Strait of Hormuz reignite Oil volatility.

item.title: Swiss Franc holds losses as fresh US-Iran tensions support the US Dollar
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) nurses minor losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday but is depreciating nearly 0.7% so far this week.

item.title: British Pound slumps against US Dollar as risky assets turn fragile
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is down 0.13% to near 1.3340 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday. The GBP/USD pair faces selling pressure as renewed geopolitical risks have diminished the appeal of riskier assets.

item.title: Polish Zloty: Dovish NBP stance weighs on PLN – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky expects the National Bank of Poland (NBP) to keep rates at 3.75% through year-end, with easing delayed until policymakers gain confidence on inflation.

item.title: Australian Dollar weakens on renewed Iran tensions ahead of Fed minutes
item.description: AUD/USD falls to around 0.6920 on Wednesday at the time of writing, down 0.13% on the day after giving back its earlier gains.

item.title: Swedish Krona: Growth strong, currency soft – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale’s Kit Juckes argues that Sweden’s strong growth and low inflation contrast with broader G10 dynamics, yet the Krona remains weak. He notes Sweden’s superior debt sustainability and recent data showing robust Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and minimal inflation.

item.title: Canadian Dollar outperforms its peers amid rallying oil prices
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) trades higher against its major currency peers, with USD/CAD sliding 0.26% to near 1.4160 during the European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: US Dollar Index: Conflict-driven support and rate backdrop – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes that renewed Middle East tensions are pressuring stocks and bonds while supporting the US Dollar (USD) and Oil.

item.title: EUR/GBP Price Forecasts: Euro holds below 0.8450 with indicators showing some bullish divergence
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is trading flat against the British Pound (GBP) on Wednesday, with bears contained above 0.8535 yet failing to find acceptance above 0.8650 so far.

item.title: Indian Rupee plummets as US-Iran ceasefire collapse lifts oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) plunges against the US Dollar (USD) in India's afternoon trading hours on Wednesday. The USD/INR pair jumps to near 95.65 as the collapse of the memorandum of understanding (MoU) between the United States (US) and Iran has lifted oil prices.

item.title: British Pound: Sterling supported as yields retrace – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny highlights that implied volatility in GBP/USD has barely moved after Nigel Farage’s decision to resign and recontest his Clacton seat, calling the by‑election a sham with potential further votes if he is sanctioned.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar gives away gains amid renewed tensions in the Middle East
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar’s (NZD) rally against the US Dollar (USD) has been short-lived, as the pair returned to sub-0.5700 levels during the European session after being rejected at the 0.5725 area earlier in the day.

item.title: US Dollar: FOMC minutes to highlight hawkish debate – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities strategists preview the June Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) Minutes, expecting more insight into the policy debate than provided by Chair Warsh’s press conference.

item.title: Gold declines as Trump scraps Iran memorandum, markets await Fed minutes
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trades around $4,050 on Wednesday, down 1.40% on the day at the time of writing, as investors favor the US Dollar (USD) following a fresh deterioration in tensions between the United States (US) and Iran.

item.title: US equities: Inflation tilt persists – BNY
item.description: Geoff Yu at BNY highlights that client flows into United States (US) equities remain geared to inflation risk, even as direct inflation-hedge sectors see reduced inflows. BNY’s iFlow equity inflation style indicator shows a wide gap between inflation-sensitive flows and falling breakevens.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Euro hesitates above 1.1400 as geopolitical risks mount
item.description: The Euro (EUR) shows marginal losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday and has returned to levels just above 1.1400 during the European trading session after rejection at 1.1430.

item.title: ECB’s Escrivá: Central bank to keep all options on a meeting-by-meeting basis
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker and Governor of the Bank of Spain, José Luis Escrivá, said on Wednesday that the central bank “will keep all options on the table and decide on a meeting-by-meeting basis.”

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Wednesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $58.56 per troy ounce, down 2.34% from the $59.97 it cost on Tuesday.

item.title: India: Cheaper Oil supports FY27 deficit target – Standard Chartered
item.description: Standard Chartered economists Anubhuti Sahay and Saurav Anand assess India’s FY27 fiscal deficit outlook, highlighting how lower crude Oil prices reduce the risk of fiscal slippage to about 0.2-0.3% of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) versus 0.5% earlier.
